content:
“You're trained for close quarters shooting.”

**Guerrilla** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

+20% ranged damage to close enemies.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | You do +20% ranged damage to close enemies. | 0031AF03 | 
| ★★ | 2 | You do +15% ranged damage to close enemies. | 0031AF02 | 
| ★ | 1 | You do +10% ranged damage to close enemies. | 0031AF01 | 

- Although the perk card art for Guerrilla depicts a MAC-11 pistol, this weapon is not available in the game.
- Before Update 58 Guerrilla provided 10%/15%/20% more damage to automatic pistols per rank.
